description: Unit test for the NullFeatureProperties class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package, testing immutability, json representations, and equality semantics.

classes.name: NullFeaturePropertiesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for NullFeatureProperties, verifying behavior such as immutability, JSON representation, and equality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture with a new instance of NullFeatureProperties.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that NullFeatureProperties is immutable, with JsonObject also being immutable.

methods.name: nullFeaturePropertiesIsJsonNull
methods.description: Asserts that the object reports itself as a JSON null.

methods.name: nullFeaturePropertiesIsJsonObject
methods.description: Asserts that the object reports itself as a JSON object.

methods.name: nullFeaturePropertiesAsJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON representation as an object equals JsonFactory.nullObject().

methods.name: createInstanceReturnsTheExpectedJson
methods.description: Checks that the JSON string output from the object is 'null'.

methods.name: nullFeaturePropertiesIsNothing
methods.description: Ensures the object is not of boolean, number, string, or array types.
